name: Trust accounting
summary: Trust accounting: reads trust balances and receipts, and queues disbursement requisitions for approval. Crons read and flag; a person approves every payment out of trust.

crons.name: balances
crons.summary: Read matter balances on each trust account and flag any matter below the floor (21:30 UTC is 7 or 8 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: receipts
crons.summary: Read trust transactions and flag any new one with no matter allocated.

crons.name: disbursements
crons.summary: Check each recorded disbursement request against the matter's trust balance, then queue a requisition for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only. A requisition moves trust money, so it is a live operation and only ever queued for a person to approve. Nothing in this workflow posts a trust transaction.

smokeball.covers: matter balances, trust transactions, disbursement requisitions (queued for approval)

gaps: Confirm the workflow steps and platform coverage with the business before enabling its crons.
Xero and MYOB: the docs read describe no trust account, matter allocation or sign-off, so no adapter is built. Their help centres need a browser read before any mapping.
Leap, Actionstep: no platform docs were read for this workflow, so they are not mapped.
Smokeball: the spec types the transactions list response as a single item. The adapter accepts an array or a value collection, and a live account must confirm the shape.
Smokeball: the matter balance read takes one page of 200. A trust account with more matters needs paging, which is not built.
Smokeball: the requisition approver defaults to the firm's default approver unless settings set one. Confirm the approval routing in a live account.
Disbursement requests have no intake route yet. The disbursements cron reads requests a person records in the workflow store, and the CRM shell does not write them yet.
Money in, allocation, trust ledger entries, bank matching, transfers to office, principal sign-off and client statements are not automated. They stay with the practice's own process.
Every adapter is docs-only until a Smokeball sandbox or trial account proves it.
